customer_message: My refund has not arrived yet
agent_reply: Refunds usually appear within five business days. Please send your order number so we can check it.

customer_message: Where is the money from my return?
agent_reply: We can check the return status with your order number and confirm the refund timeline.

customer_message: My package is late
agent_reply: Sorry about the delay. Please share your tracking number and we will check the latest delivery scan.

customer_message: The tracking has not moved in a week
agent_reply: We are sorry the tracking has stalled. Send the tracking number and our delivery team can investigate.

customer_message: I was charged twice for one order
agent_reply: We can investigate the duplicate charge. Please provide the order number and do not share full card details.

customer_message: Why did my card get charged twice?
agent_reply: Please send the order number through a private channel so we can review the duplicate payment.

customer_message: I cannot log in to my account
agent_reply: Please use the password reset link and let us know if you still cannot access the account.

customer_message: My password reset email never came
agent_reply: Check your spam folder and request another reset email. We can help further if access is still blocked.

customer_message: The app crashes when I open it
agent_reply: Please update the app and restart your device. If it still crashes, send your device model and app version.

customer_message: Your latest update broke the app
agent_reply: We are sorry about that. Please share your app version and device model so the technical team can investigate.

customer_message: I want to cancel my order
agent_reply: We can check whether the order has shipped. Please send the order number through a private channel.

customer_message: Can I stop this order before it ships?
agent_reply: We will check the order status and explain the available cancellation options.

customer_message: How do I change my plan?
agent_reply: You can review available plans in your account settings. We can help if you share which plan you want.

customer_message: I want to switch to a cheaper plan
agent_reply: We can explain the plan options and any account changes needed before switching.

customer_message: Someone accessed my account and changed the email
agent_reply: Please do not share passwords or codes. We are escalating this security issue to a specialist immediately.

customer_message: I think my account was hacked
agent_reply: For your protection, we are escalating this account-security report to a specialist.

customer_message: What are your phone plans?
agent_reply: You can compare current plans on our plans page. Tell us what usage you need and we can point you in the right direction.

customer_message: Do you support international roaming?
agent_reply: Roaming availability depends on the destination and plan. Tell us the country and plan so we can check.

customer_message: This is terrible service and I want a manager
agent_reply: We are sorry this has been frustrating. We are escalating your complaint so a specialist can review it.

customer_message: Your company stole my money
agent_reply: We are escalating this complaint for urgent human review. Please do not post payment details publicly.

customer_message: How long does delivery usually take?
agent_reply: Most orders arrive within the timeframe shown at checkout. Share your order number if your delivery is outside that window.

customer_message: Can I get a refund for my order?
agent_reply: We can review the order and explain the refund options. Please send the order number privately.

customer_message: The app shows an error when I pay
agent_reply: Please do not retry repeatedly. Share the error text and device details so our technical team can investigate.

customer_message: Please delete my account
agent_reply: We can help with account deletion after verifying the request through a private channel.
